2 Hollywood Mews, Mount Anville Road, Dublin 14

A spacious detached two-bedroom mews with two private parking spaces and an additional guest parking bay, quietly positioned in a private courtyard just off Mount Anville Road.

Russell Estate Agents are delighted to present 2 Hollywood Mews to the market. Tucked away in a small residential enclave of just three properties, this attractive detached mews offers generous accommodation, excellent privacy and a superb Dublin 14 location.

Presented in turnkey condition, the property provides an excellent opportunity for a first-time buyer, downsizer,  or investor looking for a well-located home in one of south Dublin’s most established residential areas.

The accommodation is surprisingly spacious and well-proportioned throughout. The front door opens into a bright entrance hallway, leading to a large kitchen and a generous, comfortable living room. Upstairs are two exceptionally well-sized bedrooms, positioned on either side of the shower room. Both bedrooms are bright and airy and offer excellent storage.

One of the property’s particularly useful features is its parking provision. There are two dedicated parking spaces, together with an additional guest parking bay, providing excellent convenience for residents and visitors alike.

Location

The location is a major attraction. Hollywood Mews is situated just off Mount Anville Road, within easy reach of UCD, Goatstown, Mount Merrion, Donnybrook, Stillorgan and Dundrum.

Despite its quiet and private setting, the property is close to a wide range of everyday amenities, schools, sporting facilities, parks and public transport.

Schools & Education

The area is particularly well served by schools, with a strong selection of both primary and secondary options within easy reach.

Gaelscoil Laighean is located directly on Mount Anville Road, making it an especially convenient option for families seeking Irish-medium primary education.

Other nearby primary schools include:

Mount Anville Primary School
St Laurence’s Boys’ National School
Our Lady’s Grove Primary School
Scoil San Treasa, Mount Merrion

For secondary education, nearby options include:

Mount Anville Secondary School
Coláiste Íosagáin
Coláiste Eoin
Oatlands College
St Benildus College
St Kilian’s German School

University College Dublin is also within easy walking distance, with its extensive academic, sporting and recreational facilities close at hand.

Sport & Recreation

For those who enjoy sport and the outdoors, the area offers an unusually broad choice of facilities and clubs.

Deerpark is within walking distance and provides extensive green space, walking routes and recreational facilities.

Local sporting options include Kilmacud Crokes GAA Club, St Olaf’s GAA Club, UCD Sport & Fitness, Donnybrook Lawn Tennis Club, Deerpark Tennis Club, Leopardstown Tennis Club, Milltown Golf Club and Elm Park Golf & Sports Club.

There are also numerous football, rugby, GAA, tennis, athletics and fitness facilities throughout the surrounding neighbourhoods.

Shopping, Dining & Amenities

Everyday convenience is another significant benefit of the location.

The property is within easy reach of Donnybrook, Goatstown, Mount Merrion, Stillorgan, Blackrock and Dundrum, providing an extensive choice of supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, shops and other services. 

Frascati Shopping Centre and Dundrum Town Centre are also readily accessible, offering a wide range of retail, dining, leisure and entertainment options. St Helens Hotel is located just minutes away.

The nearby villages of Donnybrook, Ranelagh and Stillorgan provide a good selection of independent cafés, restaurants and local businesses.

Transport

The property is well served by public transport, with several Dublin Bus routes operating close by.

The 11 bus route is particularly convenient, with nearby stops serving Mount Anville Road and the surrounding area and providing connections towards Goatstown, Clonskeagh, Ranelagh and Dublin city centre.

Other nearby services include the 47 and 116, with additional routes available along the N11 corridor.

The Luas Green Line is also within easy reach, with Dundrum and Kilmacud stations providing convenient connections towards Dundrum, Sandyford and Dublin city centre.

The property’s position also provides straightforward access to the N11 and M50, making commuting to other parts of Dublin and beyond convenient. Dublin Airport is readily accessible by both road and public transport.

The Property

2 Hollywood Mews offers something that can be increasingly difficult to find in this part of Dublin: a detached home with generous accommodation, privacy and excellent parking, while being within walking distance of UCD and close to some of south Dublin’s most established schools and amenities.

The quiet courtyard setting provides a sense of privacy without sacrificing convenience, with shops, schools, sporting facilities, public transport and recreational amenities all close by.

Key Features
Detached two-bedroom mews
Private courtyard setting
Two dedicated parking spaces
Additional guest parking bay
Spacious kitchen
Generous living room
Two large bedrooms
Excellent storage
Bright and well-proportioned accommodation
Turnkey condition
Walking distance to UCD
Gaelscoil Laighean on Mount Anville Road
Excellent choice of primary and secondary schools nearby
Close to Deerpark
Excellent range of GAA, tennis, golf and sporting facilities
Convenient Dublin Bus connections
Luas Green Line within easy reach
Easy access to N11 and M50
Close to Donnybrook, Stillorgan, Blackrock and Dundrum

Viewing

2 Hollywood Mews is a well-located and unusually spacious two-bedroom detached mews, offering privacy, generous accommodation and excellent parking in a quiet Dublin 14 setting.

With UCD, schools, transport links, sporting facilities, parks, shopping and dining all close by, this is a property that combines the convenience of an established south Dublin location with the privacy of a small residential courtyard.

Viewing is highly recommended.
